CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mir_conversation_private(org uuid, other uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$declare me uuid:=auth.uid();mine text;theirs text;result uuid;begin
 mine:=mir_core.staff_role(org,me);theirs:=mir_core.staff_role(org,other);
 if me=other or mine is null or theirs is null or not(
  mine='boss' or(mine='assistant' and theirs in ('employe','chef_equipe')) or
  (mine='chef_equipe' and theirs='boss') or(mine='employe' and theirs in ('assistant','boss')) or
  (mine in ('chef_equipe','employe') and theirs in ('chef_equipe','employe') and exists(select 1 from mir_core.team_members a join mir_core.team_members b on(a.organization_id,a.team_id)=(b.organization_id,b.team_id) where a.organization_id=org and a.user_id=me and b.user_id=other and a.active and b.active))
 ) then raise exception 'Conversation non autorisée' using errcode='42501';end if;
 select c.id into result from mir_core.conversations c where c.organization_id=org and c.kind='private'
 and exists(select 1 from mir_core.conversation_participants p where p.organization_id=org and p.conversation_id=c.id and p.user_id=me and p.active)
 and exists(select 1 from mir_core.conversation_participants p where p.organization_id=org and p.conversation_id=c.id and p.user_id=other and p.active)
 and (select count(*) from mir_core.conversation_participants p where p.organization_id=org and p.conversation_id=c.id and p.active)=2 limit 1;
 if result is null then result:=gen_random_uuid();insert into mir_core.conversations values(org,result,'private',null,me,now());insert into mir_core.conversation_participants values(org,result,me,true,now()),(org,result,other,true,now());end if;return result;end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mir_coordination_detail(org uuid, coord_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$
declare out jsonb;co mir_core.coordination_orders;begin
 if not(mir_core.coordination_allowed(org) or mir_core.warehouse_allowed(org)) then
 raise exception 'Accès interdit' using errcode='42501';end if;
 select * into co from mir_core.coordination_orders where organization_id=org and id=coord_id;
 if not found then raise exception 'Commande introuvable' using errcode='22023';end if;
 select jsonb_build_object('id',co.id,'sourceOrderId',co.employee_order_id,'revision',co.revision,
  'job',co.job,'address',co.delivery_address,'team',co.team,'priority',co.priority,
  'shippedAt',co.shipped_at,'notes',case when mir_core.coordination_allowed(org) then co.notes else '' end,
  'lines',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',l.id,'sourceLineId',l.employee_line_id,'name',l.item_name,'unit',l.unit,'requestedQty',l.requested_qty,
    'variantKey',l.variant_key,'routes',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',a.id,'lane',a.route,'quantity',a.quantity,'supplierId',a.supplier_id,
      'supplierOrderId',a.supplier_order_id,'receivedQty',a.received_qty,'productionStatus',a.production_status,
       'pickedQty',case when a.route='warehouse' then coalesce((select f.delivered_qty from mir_core.warehouse_fulfillment f where f.organization_id=l.organization_id and f.order_line_id=l.employee_line_id),0) else null end))
      from mir_core.coordination_routes a where a.organization_id=org and a.coordination_line_id=l.id),'[]'::jsonb))
    order by l.created_at) from mir_core.coordination_lines l
    where l.organization_id=org and l.coordination_id=co.id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'events',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'revision',e.revision,'type',e.event_type,'payload',e.payload,'actorId',e.actor_id,'at',e.created_at))
    from mir_core.coordination_events e where e.organization_id=org and e.coordination_id=co.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 ) into out;
 return out;
end$function$

 and user_id=member and role='employee' and active) then raise exception 'Employé actif requis' using errcode='22023';end if;

 return true;
end$function$

 RETURNS jsonb

 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$
declare out jsonb;begin
 if not mir_core.coordination_allowed(org) then raise exception 'Coordination non autorisée' using errcode='42501';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'sourceOrderId',o.id,'id',c.id,'revision',c.revision,
  'job',coalesce(c.job,r.snapshot->'configuration'->>'chantier',r.snapshot->>'job',''),
  'address',coalesce(c.delivery_address,r.snapshot->>'address',''),
  'team',coalesce(c.team,''),
  'priority',coalesce(c.priority,'normal'),
  'lineCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.order_lines ol where ol.organization_id=org and ol.order_id=o.id),
  'status',case when c.shipped_at is not null then 'warehouse_shipped'
   when c.id is null then 'new' else 'in_progress' end
 ) order by o.created_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) into out
 from mir_core.orders o
 left join mir_core.coordination_orders c on (c.organization_id,c.employee_order_id)=(o.organization_id,o.id)
 left join mir_core.order_revisions r on(r.organization_id,r.order_id,r.revision)=(o.organization_id,o.id,o.revision)
 where o.organization_id=org and o.kind='employee' and o.status<>'cancelled';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mir_coordination_warehouse_queue(org uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$
declare out jsonb;begin
 if not mir_core.warehouse_allowed(org) then raise exception 'Entrepôt autorisé requis' using errcode='42501';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'id',o.id,'sourceOrderId',o.employee_order_id,'revision',o.revision,'job',o.job,'address',o.delivery_address,
  'team',o.team,'priority',o.priority,'shippedAt',o.shipped_at,
  'unread',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('revision',e.revision,'type',e.event_type,
   'payload',e.payload,'at',e.created_at) order by e.created_at)
   from mir_core.coordination_events e where e.organization_id=org and e.coordination_id=o.id
   and e.event_type in ('received','routed','quantity_added','note_changed')
   and e.revision>coalesce((select a.seen_revision from mir_core.coordination_acks a
    where a.organization_id=org and a.coordination_id=o.id and a.user_id=auth.uid()),0)),'[]'::jsonb),
  'lines',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',l.id,'sourceLineId',l.employee_line_id,'skuId',f.sku_id,'qrToken',s.qr_token,
    'name',l.item_name,'unit',l.unit,'requestedQty',r.quantity,
    'pickedQty',coalesce(f.delivered_qty,0),'remainingQty',r.quantity-coalesce(f.delivered_qty,0))
    order by l.created_at)
    from mir_core.coordination_routes r
    join mir_core.coordination_lines l on(l.organization_id,l.id)=(r.organization_id,r.coordination_line_id)
    left join mir_core.warehouse_fulfillment f on(f.organization_id,f.order_line_id)=(l.organization_id,l.employee_line_id)
    left join mir_core.warehouse_skus s on(s.organization_id,s.id)=(f.organization_id,f.sku_id)
    where l.organization_id=org and l.coordination_id=o.id and r.route='warehouse'),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) order by o.updated_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) into out
 from mir_core.coordination_orders o
 where o.organization_id=org and o.shipped_at is null and exists(
 select 1 from mir_core.coordination_lines l join mir_core.coordination_routes r
 on(r.organization_id,r.coordination_line_id)=(l.organization_id,l.id)
 where l.organization_id=org and l.coordination_id=o.id and r.route='warehouse');
 return out;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mir_employee_operations_snapshot(org uuid, job uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'mir_core'
AS $function$declare role_name text:=mir_core.staff_role(org);begin
 if role_name is null and not mir_core.has_role(org,array['admin']) then raise exception 'Accès interne requis' using errcode='42501';end if;
 if job is not null and not mir_core.job_allowed(org,job) then raise exception 'Chantier non autorisé' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('role',case when role_name='admin' then 'boss' else coalesce(role_name,'boss') end,
  'teams',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'name',t.name,'leaderId',t.leader_id)) from mir_core.teams t where t.organization_id=org and t.active and (mir_core.has_role(org,array['admin']) or exists(select 1 from mir_core.team_members m where m.organization_id=org and m.team_id=t.id and m.user_id=auth.uid() and m.active))),'[]'),
  'conversations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'kind',c.kind,'teamId',c.team_id,'unread',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.user_id=auth.uid() and r.read_at is null and exists(select 1 from mir_core.messages x where x.organization_id=org and x.id=r.message_id and x.conversation_id=c.id)))) from mir_core.conversations c where c.organization_id=org and mir_core.conversation_allowed(org,c.id)),'[]'),
  'messages',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',m.id,'conversationId',m.conversation_id,'senderId',m.sender_id,'body',m.body,'jobId',m.job_id,'planDocumentId',m.plan_document_id,'attachmentPath',m.attachment_path,'sentAt',m.sent_at,'deliveredCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id and r.delivered_at is not null),'readCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id and r.read_at is not null),'recipientCount',(select count(*) from mir_core.message_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and r.message_id=m.id)) order by m.sent_at desc) from mir_core.messages m where m.organization_id=org and mir_core.conversation_allowed(org,m.conversation_id)),'[]'),
  'hrRequests',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',h.id,'employeeId',h.employee_id,'type',h.request_type,'startDate',h.start_date,'endDate',h.end_date,'status',h.status,'createdAt',h.created_at) order by h.created_at desc) from mir_core.hr_requests h where h.organization_id=org and(h.employee_id=auth.uid() or mir_core.has_role(org,array['admin']))),'[]'),
  'extras',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)-'client_request_id') from mir_core.extras e where e.organization_id=org and(job is null or e.job_id=job) and mir_core.job_allowed(org,e.job_id)),'[]'),
  'receipts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)-'client_request_id') from mir_core.delivery_receipts r where r.organization_id=org and(job is null or r.job_id=job) and mir_core.job_allowed(org,r.job_id)),'[]'),
  'issues',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)-'client_request_id') from mir_core.delivery_issues i where i.organization_id=org and(job is null or i.job_id=job) and(mir_core.job_allowed(org,i.job_id) or role_name='assistant')),'[]'),
  'activity',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.created_at desc) from mir_core.job_activity a where a.organization_id=org and(job is null or a.job_id=job) and mir_core.job_allowed(org,a.job_id)),'[]'),
  'notifications',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(n) order by n.created_at desc) from mir_core.notifications n where n.organization_id=org and n.user_id=auth.uid()),'[]'));
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.extension(name text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
    _parts text[];
    _filename text;
BEGIN
    -- Split on "/" to get path segments
    SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts;
    -- Get the last path segment (the actual filename)
    SELECT _parts[array_length(_parts, 1)] INTO _filename;
    -- Extract extension: reverse, split on '.', then reverse again
    RETURN reverse(split_part(reverse(_filename), '.', 1));
END
$function$
